subject: Loading big data ends up in connection timeout

messages.author: 28133efa6b426c06
messages.subject: Loading big data ends up in connection timeout
parts:
Hello,

I deployed an app, which is correctly loading locally and via shinyapps.io, but when it is finally loaded, the shinyapps server is disconnacting. Locally everything is working like a charm. 

My App, uses a UI, a server and a global file, in latter big data (10MB) is loaded using readRDS(). I checked the (I) log using rsconnect::showLogs(), (II) the metrics on https://www.shinyapps.io/admin/#/application/XXX/metric and (III) java scripts errors in the browser, but 
there were no errors or too much memory (<200MB) or CPU usage (80%) from the app. I use a free account.

By reducing the RDS data to a smaller subset (1MB) I was able to run the app very fast and successfully. 
Now is the question, what I can do better or change? I already set the "Read Timout" on 0 and the "Connection Timeout" to 10,000, but this improved nothing.


Thanks in advance
